fact_text: KSE-100 rebounded strongly on 8 Apr 2026 as Middle East tensions eased, with most blue-chip stocks rising except some refineries.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: Refinery companies were reported to have delayed their results releases so that windfall margin gains would not show up quickly.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: The analyst expects Hub Power to pay a dividend of about Rs5 per share per quarter.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: The analyst expects Hub Power's fourth-quarter dividend, covering March to June 2026, to be about Rs10 per share, bringing the annual total to roughly Rs20-25.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: The analyst estimated the implied dividend yield on Hub Power at about 9-10% on the expected payout.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: Meezan Bank trades at a premium price-to-book multiple, and the analyst said Islamic banks generally trade at a premium to conventional banks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: Meezan Bank pays dividends every quarter, which the analyst cited as a reason its shares recovered quickly after the market fall.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: MCB Bank still trades at a deep discount, with its share price below the level at which some shares were bought in 2008.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: Habib Metropolitan Bank earns about 30-35% of its non-core income from trade finance, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: A rate rise would force banks to book mark-to-market losses on fixed-rate bond portfolios, but the analyst thought the impact could be limited.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: Some had talked of a much larger policy-rate rise, but the analyst expected only about 100 basis points of increase and said a hold would help banks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: The analyst said UBL would become attractive again if rates are not raised, because banks would avoid large bond-price losses.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: The analyst suggested the government may cut petrol prices, which would help trade and industry by easing input-cost inflation.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: The government had cut the industrial electricity tariff by about Rs4 per kWh, and the analyst hoped the lower tariff would hold to help textile and other manufacturers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: Chemical companies in Faisalabad and Lahore, including caustic soda producers, are expanding, and the analyst sees them benefiting if energy costs stay stable.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: Construction activity is sluggish, which weighs on steel and cement demand, though the analyst said it could improve if the sector recovers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: Mughal Iron and Steel, a Lahore-based long-steel maker that also exports to China, could benefit if electricity tariffs stay stable.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: Fatima Fertilizer has a strong balance sheet with limited borrowing, receives carbon-related income, and pays regular dividends, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: The analyst highlighted Engro Fertilizers alongside Fatima Fertilizer as dividend-paying names for a fertilizer-sector portfolio.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: Urea price was cited at about Rs4,500, and DAP prices were described as very high.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)

fact_text: Millat Tractors exports to Africa, and the analyst sees rising African demand; better local assembly conditions could help tractor sales recover.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 Surges as Middle East Tensions Ease | MCB MEBL FATIMA | Midday Flash | April 8, 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-08)
